away.summary: The St. Louis Blues are coming off a 4-0 win against the Dallas Stars. They have several injured players, including Logan Mailloux, Tyler Tucker, and Alexey Toropchenko, and have scratched Zach Dean and Justin Barron. Mason McTavish has been added to the lineup as the new second-line center, and the team is looking to build on their strong start.

home.summary: The Colorado Avalanche have confirmed their projected lineup, with Noah Juulsen as the starting goalie. They have two injured players, Logan O’Connor and Zachary L’Heureux, who are day-to-day. The team is led by coach Jared Bednar, who has signed a four-year contract through the 2030-31 season. The Avalanche are looking to continue their strong start with a 1-0-0 record.
